definition: CallMiner is a Massachusetts-based customer experience (CX) automation software company.
details: Founded in 2002, it is headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts with offices in the United Kingdom and Prague. CallMiner develops software that uses artificial intelligence to analyze conversations between businesses and their customers. These interactions may be voice-based and occur over the phone, or text-based and occur over digital channels such as online reviews, chat, surveys, email, social media messaging, and more. Organizations use the resulting insights to improve automation, operational efficiency, and agent performance.

explainer.lead: CallMiner builds software that helps businesses learn from conversations with their customers, whether those conversations happen by phone or through digital text channels. Its AI-based analysis turns those interactions into insights that organizations can use to improve automation, efficiency, and agent performance.

tiers.eli5: Imagine a shop receiving thousands of phone calls, messages, and reviews, with no time to study every one carefully. CallMiner makes software that helps a business examine those conversations and learn from them. The business can then use what it learns to serve customers better and help its staff work more effectively.
tiers.practitioner: Teams apply CallMiner to voice conversations and text from channels such as chat, email, surveys, online reviews, and social media messaging. The resulting insights can inform automation projects, operational improvements, and work on agent performance. Keep the input channels and intended operational use clear when interpreting the analysis.
tiers.paperLevel: CallMiner is a customer experience automation company whose software can be represented as: customer interactions I, including voice and digital text, -> AI-based conversation analysis -> organizational insights. Those insights are intended to support automation, operational efficiency, and agent performance.

explainer.example: A business gathers customer phone calls alongside chat transcripts, emails, survey responses, and online reviews. CallMiner analyzes these interactions, and the business uses the resulting insights to identify where automation or operational changes could help and where agent performance could improve.
